logicalStrokes.name: 撇

logicalStrokes.exit: long leftward release balances the first oblique dot

logicalStrokes.name: 提
logicalStrokes.exit: upward directional release toward 子, with an airborne gap

logicalStrokes.name: 横撇
logicalStrokes.entry: soft rising shoulder differs from long crossbar
logicalStrokes.exit: rounded folded entry into the same-point 子 stem

logicalStrokes.name: 竖钩
logicalStrokes.entry: same-point tangent continuation; no extra connector segment
logicalStrokes.exit: rounded pressure turn then short leftward release

logicalStrokes.name: 横
logicalStrokes.entry: light lower press answering the left rising tie
logicalStrokes.exit: full, restrained exit; no long needle tail
